title: Shielded reinforcement learning for exothermic semi-batch dosing under model mismatch: code and results
description: Code, trained TD3 agents and result tables for a simulation study of a hard safety shield (backup-policy look-ahead with an MTSR end point, checked on worst-case corner models) around a reinforcement-learning dosing agent for exothermic semi-batch reactors. Two reactors: acetic anhydride hydrolysis in a 1 L lab reactor, and the A + B -> C benchmark of Fricz et al. (2026). Simulation only; not a design for a real plant.
